statusLine.command: input=$(cat); dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir' | sed "s|$HOME|~|"); branch=$(cd "$dir" 2>/dev/null && git -c core.fileMode=false branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // empty'); usage=$(echo "$input" | jq '.context_window.current_usage'); if [ "$usage" != "null" ]; then current=$(echo "$usage" | jq '.input_tokens + .cache_creation_input_tokens + .cache_read_input_tokens'); size=$(echo "$input" | jq '.context_window.context_window_size'); pct=$((current * 100 / size)); ctx_info=$(printf '[%d%% ctx]' "$pct"); else ctx_info=''; fi; if [ -n "$branch" ]; then printf '%s (%s) %s [%s]' "$dir" "$branch" "$ctx_info" "$model"; else printf '%s %s [%s]' "$dir" "$ctx_info" "$model"; fi
